captures.vehicle_state: stationary in a safe state; stabilize near 1500, 2000, then 2500 rpm, marking each transition

captures.vehicle_state: stationary, parking brake applied; record P, R, N, D and each available manual/paddle up/down action one at a time

captures.vehicle_state: stationary; press one control at a time and mark its timestamp
operator_marked_controls: each stalk button and stalk direction, individually
low/high beam and other available lighting states
left/right turn signals and hazard lights
captures.notes: Do not infer all-door state from the single driver-door contact. Button/stalk observations are raw differential candidates until the actual frame or ECU DID is identified.

captures.notes: Keep vehicle operation independent of the operator capturing data; DQ-hybrid gear codes remain candidate until matched against DQ500 state.
